description: 승인된 단일 대상의 제한된 포트 확인. 원본 네트워크·서버 증거와 대조하고 발견과 취약점 성공을 구분한다.

target.description: 운영자가 미리 승인 목록에 고정한 대상

exec.code:
import datetime, ipaddress, json, re, shutil, subprocess, sys

def stop(reason, status="not_run"):
    print(json.dumps({"status": status, "reason": reason}, ensure_ascii=False))
    raise SystemExit(2)

params = json.load(sys.stdin)
run_id = params.get("run_id", "")
if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}", run_id):
    stop("run_id must contain 1-64 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens")

# Operator fills this only after the target and execution scope are approved.
APPROVED_IPV4 = []
APPROVED_PORTS = []
target = params.get("target", "")
try:
    target = str(ipaddress.IPv4Address(target))
except (ValueError, TypeError):
    stop("one IPv4 address is required; hostnames and CIDRs are not accepted")
if target not in APPROVED_IPV4 or not APPROVED_PORTS:
    stop("approved target/ports are not configured")
if any(type(p) is not int or not 1 <= p <= 65535 for p in APPROVED_PORTS):
    stop("approved ports are invalid")
binary = shutil.which("nmap")
if not binary:
    stop("nmap is unavailable in the ARTEX execution environment")
argv = [binary, "-sT", "-Pn", "-n", "--max-rate", "5", "--max-retries", "0",
        "--host-timeout", "30s", "-p", ",".join(map(str, APPROVED_PORTS)), "-oX", "-", target]
started_at = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
try:
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=35, check=False)
    print(json.dumps({"status": "executed", "run_id": run_id,
        "started_at": started_at,
        "argv": argv, "exit_code": result.returncode,
        "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}, ensure_ascii=False))
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(1)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    stop("nmap wrapper timed out; inspect independent network/server logs before classifying result", "incomplete")
